extra_context: We're Iron Anvil CrossFit, a community box on the east side of town for everyday people who want to get strong together, not gym bros chasing mirror selfies. We coach real humans through tough WODs and we want the site to hit you with that pumped-up, you-belong-here energy the second it loads. Our signature thing is the 6am "First Light" crew that finishes every workout ringing the PR bell and grabbing coffee from the trailer parked out front.
